Maine Claude ko **Instagram Edits** aur **DaVinci Resolve** se jod diya. Ab edit **bolkar** hota hai.
Dekho: **ek prompt**, aur **clips, subtitles, music**, sab timeline pe lag gaye.
Par log yahin **atakte** hain. Edits sirf **Apple silicon** Mac pe chalta hai, aur **free Resolve** mein Blackmagic bahar se control **band** rakhta hai.
**Edits 1.** Instagram ki site se Mac ke liye Edits **download** karo, aur apne Instagram se **sign in** karo.
**Edits 2.** **Settings** kholo, **Automation** pe jao, aur **Enable Automation Server** on karo. Wahin Claude Code ke liye **Copy** dikhega.
**Edits 3.** Copy dabao, **Terminal** mein paste karke Enter. Phir Claude Desktop **poora band** karke dobara kholo.
**Edits 4.** Claude se poochho: Edits ke **tools** kya hain? List aa gayi, toh **connected.**
Ab **Resolve.** Free edition mein **bridge andar se** chalta hai. Claude Code mein **teen commands** paste karo, phir Resolve ek baar **restart** karo.
Phir **Workspace, Scripts, Claude MCP Bridge** pe ek click. **/mcp** mein **davinci connected** dikhega.

Ab **dono ek saath.** Bolo: Resolve mein is folder ke clips **import** karo, **timeline** banao, **render** karo. Phir bolo: Edits mein is render se **vertical reel** banao, **subtitles** aur **music** ke saath.
Reel timeline pe **taiyaar.** Haath se **tweak** karo, aur seedha **post** karo.
Atak gaye? **Teen fix.** **Ek:** Claude ko Edits ke tools nahi dikh rahe? Claude Desktop **poora band** karke dobara kholo.
**Do:** bridge is not running? Resolve mein **project kholo** aur bridge **dobara click** karo.
**Teen:** Claude atak gaya? Resolve mein koi **popup** khula hoga. Use **band** karo.
Poora **guide** chahiye? Comment karo **EDIT.** Commands **DM** mein aa jayenge. Aur yeh reel **Claude ne banayi** hai.
